Check that a panel has enough snapshots

dot-check_panel_snapshots.Rd

Panel analyses that compare consecutive snapshots (decrement rates, movement and exit rates, ...) need a minimum number of distinct reference dates. Callers count the distinct, non-missing dates themselves, so the check works the same for in-memory and database tables.

Usage

.check_panel_snapshots(
  n_snaps,
  min_snaps = 2L,
  arg = "data",
  ref_date_col = "ref_date"
)

Arguments

n_snaps

Integer. Number of distinct, non-missing reference dates in the panel.

min_snaps

Integer. Minimum number of snapshots required. Default 2, the fewest that form one consecutive pair.

arg

Character. Name of the argument holding the panel, used in the error message.

ref_date_col

Character. Name of the reference date column, used in the error message.

Value

n_snaps, invisibly. Stops with an error if it is below min_snaps.
